content.json:
# Teams Premium & CMK Compliance Dashboard
---
This workbook tracks user compliance for Teams Premium licensing and Customer Managed Key (CMK) enablement across your tenant.

**Last Refreshed:** {TimeRange:label}

parameters.name: TargetSecurityGroup
parameters.label: Target Security Group (ObjectId)
parameters.description: Optional: Filter to users who should have Teams Premium

content.query:
// Teams Premium License Compliance Summary
// Teams Premium SKU Part Number: Microsoft_Teams_Premium
let TeamsPremiumSKU = "Microsoft_Teams_Premium";
let lookbackDays = 30;
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookbackDays * 1d)
| summarize LastSignIn = max(TimeGenerated) by UserPrincipalName, UserId
| join kind=leftouter (
    AuditLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
    | where OperationName == "Add member to group" or OperationName == "Change user license"
    | where Result == "success"
    | extend ModifiedProps = parse_json(tostring(TargetResources[0].modifiedProperties))
    | extend AssignedLicenses = tostring(ModifiedProps[0].newValue)
    | where AssignedLicenses contains TeamsPremiumSKU or AssignedLicenses contains "Teams Premium"
    | extend TargetUser = tostring(TargetResources[0].userPrincipalName)
    | summarize HasTeamsPremium = true by TargetUser
) on $left.UserPrincipalName == $right.TargetUser
| extend ComplianceStatus = iff(isnotempty(HasTeamsPremium) and HasTeamsPremium == true, "Compliant", "Non-Compliant")
| summarize 
    TotalUsers = dcount(UserPrincipalName),
    CompliantUsers = dcountif(UserPrincipalName, ComplianceStatus == "Compliant"),
    NonCompliantUsers = dcountif(UserPrincipalName, ComplianceStatus == "Non-Compliant")
| extend ComplianceRate = round(todouble(CompliantUsers) / todouble(TotalUsers) * 100, 1)
content.title: Teams Premium License Summary

content.query:
// CMK-Protected Meeting Policy Compliance
// Tracks users assigned to meeting policies with CMK protection
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
| where OperationName contains "meeting policy" or OperationName contains "MeetingPolicy"
| where Result == "success"
| extend PolicyDetails = parse_json(tostring(TargetResources[0].modifiedProperties))
| extend PolicyName = tostring(PolicyDetails[0].newValue)
| extend TargetUser = tostring(TargetResources[0].userPrincipalName)
| where PolicyName contains "CMK" or PolicyName contains "Protected" or PolicyName contains "Secure"
| summarize 
    CMKPolicyUsers = dcount(TargetUser),
    LastPolicyAssignment = max(TimeGenerated)
| extend Status = iff(CMKPolicyUsers > 0, "CMK Policies Active", "No CMK Policies Found")
content.title: CMK Meeting Policy Summary

content.query:
// Detailed User Compliance Status
// Shows each user's Teams Premium and CMK status
let TeamsPremiumSKU = "Microsoft_Teams_Premium";
let ActiveUsers = SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize LastSignIn = max(TimeGenerated) by UserPrincipalName, UserId, UserDisplayName
| where isnotempty(UserPrincipalName);
let TeamsPremiumUsers = AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
| where OperationName == "Change user license" and Result == "success"
| extend ModifiedProps = parse_json(tostring(TargetResources[0].modifiedProperties))
| extend AssignedLicenses = tostring(ModifiedProps)
| where AssignedLicenses contains TeamsPremiumSKU or AssignedLicenses contains "Teams Premium"
| extend TargetUser = tostring(TargetResources[0].userPrincipalName)
| summarize TeamsPremiumAssigned = true, LicenseAssignedDate = max(TimeGenerated) by TargetUser;
let CMKPolicyUsers = AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
| where OperationName contains "meeting policy" or OperationName contains "MeetingPolicy"
| where Result == "success"
| extend PolicyDetails = parse_json(tostring(TargetResources[0].modifiedProperties))
| extend PolicyName = tostring(PolicyDetails)
| extend TargetUser = tostring(TargetResources[0].userPrincipalName)
| where PolicyName contains "CMK" or PolicyName contains "Protected" or PolicyName contains "Secure"
| summarize CMKPolicyAssigned = true, PolicyAssignedDate = max(TimeGenerated) by TargetUser;
ActiveUsers
| join kind=leftouter TeamsPremiumUsers on $left.UserPrincipalName == $right.TargetUser
| join kind=leftouter CMKPolicyUsers on $left.UserPrincipalName == $right.TargetUser1
| extend 
    TeamsPremiumStatus = iff(TeamsPremiumAssigned == true, "✅ Licensed", "❌ Not Licensed"),
    CMKPolicyStatus = iff(CMKPolicyAssigned == true, "✅ Assigned", "⚠️ Not Assigned"),
    OverallCompliance = iff(TeamsPremiumAssigned == true and CMKPolicyAssigned == true, "Fully Compliant", 
                        iff(TeamsPremiumAssigned == true, "Partial - Missing CMK Policy", "Non-Compliant"))
| project 
    UserPrincipalName,
    UserDisplayName,
    LastSignIn,
    TeamsPremiumStatus,
    LicenseAssignedDate,
    CMKPolicyStatus,
    PolicyAssignedDate,
    OverallCompliance
| order by OverallCompliance asc, UserDisplayName asc
content.title: User Compliance Status

content.query:
// Non-Compliant Users - For Alert Integration
let TeamsPremiumSKU = "Microsoft_Teams_Premium";
let ActiveUsers = SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize LastSignIn = max(TimeGenerated) by UserPrincipalName, UserId, UserDisplayName
| where isnotempty(UserPrincipalName);
let TeamsPremiumUsers = AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
| where OperationName == "Change user license" and Result == "success"
| extend ModifiedProps = parse_json(tostring(TargetResources[0].modifiedProperties))
| extend AssignedLicenses = tostring(ModifiedProps)
| where AssignedLicenses contains TeamsPremiumSKU or AssignedLicenses contains "Teams Premium"
| extend TargetUser = tostring(TargetResources[0].userPrincipalName)
| summarize TeamsPremiumAssigned = true by TargetUser;
let CMKPolicyUsers = AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
| where OperationName contains "meeting policy" or OperationName contains "MeetingPolicy"
| extend PolicyDetails = parse_json(tostring(TargetResources[0].modifiedProperties))
| extend PolicyName = tostring(PolicyDetails)
| extend TargetUser = tostring(TargetResources[0].userPrincipalName)
| where PolicyName contains "CMK" or PolicyName contains "Protected" or PolicyName contains "Secure"
| summarize CMKPolicyAssigned = true by TargetUser;
ActiveUsers
| join kind=leftouter TeamsPremiumUsers on $left.UserPrincipalName == $right.TargetUser
| join kind=leftouter CMKPolicyUsers on $left.UserPrincipalName == $right.TargetUser1
| where TeamsPremiumAssigned != true or CMKPolicyAssigned != true
| extend 
    MissingItems = strcat(
        iff(TeamsPremiumAssigned != true, "Teams Premium License", ""),
        iff(TeamsPremiumAssigned != true and CMKPolicyAssigned != true, ", ", ""),
        iff(CMKPolicyAssigned != true, "CMK Meeting Policy", "")
    )
| project 
    UserPrincipalName,
    UserDisplayName,
    LastSignIn,
    MissingItems,
    ActionRequired = "Assign missing items to user"
| order by UserDisplayName asc
content.title: Users Requiring Remediation

content.query:
// Teams Premium License Assignment Trend
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where OperationName == "Change user license" and Result == "success"
| extend ModifiedProps = parse_json(tostring(TargetResources[0].modifiedProperties))
| extend AssignedLicenses = tostring(ModifiedProps)
| where AssignedLicenses contains "Teams Premium" or AssignedLicenses contains "Microsoft_Teams_Premium"
| summarize LicenseAssignments = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Teams Premium License Assignments Over Time

content.query:
// Meeting Policy Assignment Trend
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where OperationName contains "meeting policy" or OperationName contains "MeetingPolicy"
| where Result == "success"
| summarize PolicyAssignments = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Meeting Policy Assignments Over Time

content.query:
// Recent License and Policy Changes
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where OperationName == "Change user license" 
    or OperationName contains "meeting policy" 
    or OperationName contains "MeetingPolicy"
| where Result == "success"
| extend 
    TargetUser = tostring(TargetResources[0].userPrincipalName),
    InitiatedBy = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName),
    ChangeType = case(
        OperationName == "Change user license", "License Change",
        OperationName contains "meeting policy", "Meeting Policy Change",
        "Other"
    )
| project 
    TimeGenerated,
    ChangeType,
    TargetUser,
    InitiatedBy,
    OperationName,
    Result
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
content.title: Recent Changes (Last 100)
